Onboarding: your first two weeks on the data team

Day one is mostly accounts. Your manager will have requested access to Snowflake, Looker, and the team Slack channels before you arrive; if anything is missing, ask Hernandez, who handles access requests.

During the first week, read the three design docs pinned in #data-team and shadow one on-call shift with Lindqvist. In the second week, pick a starter ticket from the Jira board; these are small fixes scoped to take a day or two.

At the end of week two, you and your manager will agree on your first real project.

labels.notes: Surnames alone (Hernandez, Lindqvist) and product names are not errors.
